scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic proof of a conditional edge-mixture identity, weighted-biregularity criterion, universal complete-bipartite classification, and algebraic exceptional-set bound; finite exact-rational checks are corroboration rather than an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Connected bipartite simple graphs, strictly positive fixed within-class weight ratios, unordered edge observations and symmetric edge-only opinion updates. Identifiability requires known within-class weight ratios. No assertion about directed observations, empirical validation, all vertex weights jointly, nonbipartite networks, or physical event-time rates.
title: Exact activity-scale identifiability boundary in node-weighted opinion dynamics
